story: Essentials of Christ Mission (ECM) began with a simple conviction: that the teachings of Jesus Christ are the essentials of every Christian faith. What started as a small gathering of believers hungry for the Word has grown into a vibrant church family in Lashibi, Tema.

Under the leadership of Pastor Dr. Samuel E. Tandoh, ECM has become a place where people encounter God through heartfelt worship, sound Bible teaching and genuine fellowship. Through ministries like Go Ye, we carry the love of Christ beyond our walls to prisons, communities and anyone in need.
vision: To raise a people who know Christ, live like Christ and make Christ known in every sphere of life.
mission: To teach and project the essentials of the teachings of Jesus Christ, build up believers through the Word and prayer, and reach the lost with the gospel through outreach and missions.

statementOfFaith.title: The Bible
statementOfFaith.text: We believe the Bible is the inspired, infallible Word of God and our final authority for faith and life.

statementOfFaith.title: God
statementOfFaith.text: We believe in one God, eternally existing in three persons: Father, Son and Holy Spirit.

statementOfFaith.title: Jesus Christ
statementOfFaith.text: We believe Jesus Christ is the Son of God, born of a virgin, who died for our sins, rose bodily from the dead and is coming again. He is the Way, the Truth and the Life.

statementOfFaith.title: Salvation
statementOfFaith.text: We believe salvation is by grace through faith in Jesus Christ alone, and that all who believe are born again by the Holy Spirit.

statementOfFaith.title: The Holy Spirit
statementOfFaith.text: We believe in the present ministry of the Holy Spirit, who empowers believers to live godly lives and to serve with spiritual gifts.

statementOfFaith.title: The Church
statementOfFaith.text: We believe the Church is the body of Christ, called to worship God, grow in love and make disciples of all nations.

leaders.name: Pastor Dr. Samuel E. Tandoh
leaders.bio: Pastor Dr. Samuel E. Tandoh leads Essentials of Christ Mission with a passion for teaching the Word of God with clarity and power. His messages call believers back to the essentials of the faith and equip them to live victoriously.
